records.issue_text: **`app/models/embeddable_host.rb:2`** — the format regex `\.[a-z]{2,5}` rejects TLDs longer than 5 characters (`.technology`, `.international`, etc.), unnecessarily restricting valid hostnames admins can register.

This explicitly rejects valid hostnames with TLDs longer than 5 characters (e.g., `.technology`), preventing admins from registering legitimate embeddable hosts. That is a concrete correctness/behavior defect in the diff.

records.issue_text: **`db/migrate/...rb:24`** — the data-carryover `INSERT` builds SQL via raw string interpolation (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) rather than quoting/binding. Low risk since values originate from previously-admin-entered site settings, but a hostname containing a single quote would break the migration.
records.rationale: In `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb`, the migration iterates `records.each do |h|` and executes `INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)` via string interpolation. This is directly visible in the diff and can break the migration (or worse) if any stored host value contains a single quote or other SQL-significant characters, since it is not quoted/escaped/bound.
